class.name: OpenWorldRockGenerator3D
class.brief_description: Agent-first deterministic rock generator and baker.
class.description: Separates validate, topology, mesh generation, report, and bake operations for headless use.

method.name: clear_generated_rock
method.description: Clears generated topology, meshes, and collision.

method.name: generate_rock
method.description: Generates topology, three LOD meshes, collision, and report.

method.name: generate_topology
method.description: Generates only the canonical LOD0 topology.

method.name: get_generated_collision_shape
method.description: Returns the generated convex collision shape.

method.name: get_generation_report
method.description: Returns validation, hull, LOD, collision, and hash fields.

method.name: get_lod_statistics
method.description: Returns vertices, triangles, AABB, and base plane.

method.name: get_generated_collision_points
method.description: Returns the deterministic collision point cloud, including when no PhysicsServer is initialized.

members.member: Regenerates on request changes in the scene tree.

signal.name: rock_generated
signal.description: Emitted with LOD0 after successful generation.
